description: High-risk Annex III 5(c): AI used for risk assessment and pricing in life and health insurance for natural persons. High-risk (WARN + obligations). Illustrative only; synthetic text.

positives.text: Price each applicant's health insurance premium from a model of their predicted medical risk.
Assess life insurance risk per applicant and set the premium and acceptance decision automatically.
Berechne die Krankenversicherungsprämie jedes Antragstellers aus einem Modell des vorhergesagten medizinischen Risikos.
Bewerte je Antragsteller das Lebensversicherungsrisiko und lege Prämie und Annahmeentscheidung automatisch fest.

hard_negatives.text: Price commercial cargo insurance for a shipping company using fleet and route data (not a natural person).
